description: Sync and async Python client library for the Frontal API, with httpx transports, Pydantic v2 boundary models, service resources, and SSE streaming.
rules: The PyPI distribution is named frontal and its import package is frontal_sdk; support Python 3.9 through 3.12.
Use contracts/sdk-endpoints.json and contracts/openapi as the source of truth for endpoint methods and paths.
Keep shared transport behavior in frontal_sdk/core, boundary models in frontal_sdk/models, service methods in frontal_sdk/resources, and the sync and async clients in frontal_sdk/client.py.
Use uv with the Hatchling backend, ruff, mypy --strict, pytest, and anyio as configured in pyproject.toml.
Ship inline typing and frontal_sdk/py.typed, and keep tests offline with RESPX.
